article_notes: 50 dogs with acute large Babesia infection (smear only, species not typed; Ukraine, university clinic) compared with 50 healthy control dogs. All results (Tables 2-8: platelets, platelet and erythrocyte aggregation, CBC, ESR, haemorheology, blood pressure and shock index, coagulogram, fibrinolysis, SFMC, FDP, fibrinogen) are infected vs healthy and were not extracted. Three dogs died and 14% had haemorrhages, but no marker is compared between these dogs and the others. Sample timing relative to treatment is not stated.
